run_adsorb_atoms: run adsorb_atoms to relax an adslab system and compute adsorption energy with a given calculator
compute_hybrid_adsorption_energy: compute hybrid adsorption energy using ML-relaxed adslab energy and DFT slab energy
compute_full_adsorption_energy: compute full adsorption energy by relaxing both the adslab and bare surface with an ML calculator
save_relaxed_adslab_atoms: save relaxed adslab atoms as JSON-encoded output after running adsorb_atoms with save_relaxed_atoms enabled
review_adsorb_atoms: review the adsorb_atoms function to understand how it computes direct, hybrid, and full adsorption energies
